why: Canary 1.1 returned 10 HTTP 5xx responses during the 120 s test while the three stable 1.0 pods returned 0 (claim 1). Every canary 5xx was on /checkout: 10 of 483 canary checkout requests failed (2.07%) versus 0 of 1455 on stable (claim 2). The failures are spread over all four 30 s windows (1, 3, 3, 3), so they are not a single startup blip (claim 3). Canary latency is not worse than stable: its overall p95 is within 5 ms of stable's p95 (claim 4). Judgement: the only regression is an error class that stable does not produce at all, and it sits on the revenue-critical checkout path and persists for the whole test, so promoting to 100% would extrapolate to roughly 2% of all checkouts failing; the clean latency profile does not offset that. Judgement: rollback, fix the checkout 500s, and re-run the canary.
